For each stable support B, the explicit ground-field divisor -K+2B decomposes as P=(-K+B), N=B, with P nef on all ten Mori generators and P^2=5+|B|>0, proving sufficiency. The finite action on all 76 supports yields a complete seven-class orbit table, analytic fixed formula, and zeta identity for all extension degrees. The extracted standalone verifier checked all 120 permutations and the two enumeration methods. Classical classification and realizability of cyclic Frobenius actions bridge finite permutation tests to all smooth degree-five del Pezzo forms over all finite fields.

value.rationale: The object is the complete geometric Zariski-chamber decomposition of a canonical rational surface, and the invariant is descent of its negative-part support chambers over every finite field. The seven rows exhaust every arithmetic form and every extension field. The 4-cycle has no individually rational exceptional curve but has a non-nef rational Zariski chamber; the 5-cycle has none, a substantive contrast between arithmetic Mori rays and arithmetic stable-negative supports. The result is a complete natural arithmetic classification, not a selected computer sample, recomputation of geometric 76, or unmotivated narrowly sliced invariant.
